Veilo Authenticator generates time-based (TOTP) and counter-based (HOTP) one-time passwords for two-step verification. It works entirely offline — no internet connection, no account, no tracking.

• Keys stored in hardware-backed Android Keystore (StrongBox when available)
• Biometric or device credential required to unlock
• Screen capture and app-switcher preview blocked
• Copied codes cleared from clipboard in 30 seconds
• Secret key material zeroed in memory after use
• Root and debugger detection at launch
• No internet permission — fully air-gapped by design
• No analytics, no tracking, no third-party services
• Encrypted backup with passphrase-based key derivation
• ProGuard/R8 code obfuscation in release builds
• Cloud backup and device transfer explicitly disabled

Self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted corporate messaging platform for closed networks. Your data never leaves your infrastructure.

• Zero-Trust mesh VPN, works without internet
• Signal Protocol device-level encryption
• Full admin control: users, devices, audit logs
• Messaging, voice/video calls, file sharing
• Screen capture blocking, remote device wipe, biometric lock
• KVKK, GDPR and ISO 27001 compliant

End-to-end encrypted, Zero-Trust enterprise ecosystem that manages all your devices from a single panel.

• Axon Core: encrypted file transfer, multi-device terminal, Docker/SSH/Nginx management
• Axon Data Engine: real-time CPU/RAM/disk monitoring, uptime and SLA tracking, centralized log search
• Axon Guard: CIS security audit, network scanner, Fail2ban and firewall control
• 99.9% uptime SLA, multi-platform (Linux, Windows, ARM)

Real-time attack detection and automated response platform that runs entirely on your own infrastructure — zero cloud dependency.

• Sigma rule engine: detects SSH brute-force, port scans and more in under 5 seconds
• Attack chain correlation and 0–100 risk scoring with MITRE ATT&CK mapping
• SOAR: automated IP blocking, host isolation via YAML playbooks
• Deception layer: honeypot services and honeytokens
• Works in air-gapped environments
• Multi-tenant with edge collector support

Zero-knowledge password vault for teams. Your master password never reaches the server — derived on-device with Argon2id.

• AES-256-GCM and RSA-OAEP encryption
• Active threat intelligence: detects brute-force, credential stuffing, anomalous access
• Role-based access control and shared vaults
• Full audit log and data sovereignty
• Mobile app with PIN/biometric unlock
• Self-hosted, KVKK compliant

In Google Authenticator, tap ⋯ → Transfer accounts → Export accounts. A QR code will appear — scan it here.
In Microsoft Authenticator, go to Settings → Backup, then Transfer accounts → Export to a QR code. Scan it here.
In Aegis, tap ⋯ → Export → Choose format: Plain text, then save the JSON file and select it here.
Generates a PDF with one QR code per account. You can print it and store it in a safe place as an offline backup. Each QR code can be scanned by any authenticator app.
This PDF contains your secret keys in plain form. Anyone with this document can generate your 2FA codes. Keep it in a physically secure location.
